newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to firm, gas oil strong.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to firm, gas oil strong.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to firmer on Thursday, traders said.
Naphtha was steady. Scarce full cargoes were pegged around the $202-4 a tonne level with refiners offering 5-10kt pieces at around $195 a tonne fob NWE.
Gasoline prices steadied late. Firmer NYMEX futures stirred arbitrage interest and barge market activity was brisk.
Gas oil was strong as futures rallied on short-covering. Barge premiums were pushed higher on tight prompt supply.
High sulphur fuel oil cargo offer prices drifted higher but buyers appeared to have shied away.
